headline: Fisherman's Row Erupts Anew as Central Fronts Reel Under Relentless Bombardment
war_summary: Violent combat has flared anew across Fisherman's Row, upending the Colonial consolidation reported hours earlier as eight rapid base upheavals left the island theatre splintered into a seven-to-one division with one redoubt reduced to ash. Across the Weathered Expanse, where four fresh base actions struck within the last two hours, the grinding battle around Frostmarch and Crow's Nest shows no exhaustion, bleeding both sides at an accelerating rate of more than six hundred casualties per hour and leaving two strongholds in ruined neutrality. Strategic shifts have also cracked Callahan's Passage, where Crumbling Post fell into neutral hands amidst surging enlistments and over two thousand casualties in two hours. Along the Farranac Coast, renewed engagements severed Colonial exclusivity around The Bone Haft, while Mooring County continues to witness heavy bloodletting despite static borders. By contrast, the bitter contest across the Stlican Shelf has tapered off markedly following earlier Warden gains, and sectors such as Dead Lands and Godcrofts remain entirely stagnant behind solidified Colonial defensive lines.
